Projects

CheckShop — Sentiment Analyzer

natural language processing

An e-commerce review sentiment analyzer that classifies reviews into positive, neutral, or negative — comparing four models side by side with per-class probability breakdowns, on a dataset of ~8,600 e-commerce reviews.

Python, scikit-learn, XGBoost, HuggingFace Transformers (BERT), Streamlit

View on GitHub Live Demo

Real-Time Hand Gesture Recognition

computer vision

A real-time American Sign Language (ASL) recognition system built on a classical ML pipeline — HOG, LBP, and Hu Moments feature descriptors feeding a linear SVM — reaching 98.79% accuracy across 29 gesture classes on CPU-only hardware, no GPU required. Co-authored with 4 teammates; published as a research paper.

Python, OpenCV, scikit-learn, Flask, HOG/LBP/Hu Moments, SVM

View on GitHub

Spec2Price — Laptop Price Predictor

machine learning

A Streamlit app that estimates a laptop's market price from its specs — brand, processor, RAM, storage, display and GPU — using a Gradient Boosting model trained on 991 laptops (R² = 0.93).

Python, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas, Streamlit
